Hi Hideo / Natalie,

Apologies again for the confusion — thank you for flagging the screenshot. I’ve attached a manual calendar invite (.ics) that explicitly sets the timezone to Asia/Tokyo. The event is:

  Bluewave — Redwood demo
  When: Fri Apr 21, 2028, 10:00–10:30 AM JST (Asia/Tokyo)

Marissa has attached the agenda and the invite (calendar-invite-camila.ics). Vivek will join from our side and will cover runtime perf/quantization questions.

A short note on the root cause: we’ve seen Calendly sometimes present times using the browser locale instead of the event host timezone, which can display misleading local times for international attendees. Workarounds we use:
- Send a manual .ics that hardcodes TZ (what I did here).
- Add a parenthetical with the attendee’s local time in the email: e.g., "10:00 JST (18:00 PDT)".
- If recurring issue with the account, create a dedicated Calendly event pinned to Asia/Tokyo or use Chili Piper for APAC flows.

If the time above works, please accept the attached invite. If not, you can also pick a different slot here (I’ll prioritize APAC times): https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-apac
